After rewriting quantize_bvh for the child-pair layout I ran `grep -rn 'kInvalidNode' src/pt_bvh.cpp include/*.hpp` (plus `grep -n 'constexpr\|static const' src/pt_bvh.cpp` to find where to declare it). It showed exactly one hit — src/pt_bvh.cpp:399, `std::vector<unsigned int> block(bvh.nodes.size(), kInvalidNode);` — i.e. the only reference in the whole tree was the one my own new code had just introduced, with no definition anywhere (nothing in include/*.hpp). The constexpr grep confirmed the only existing constant was `constexpr float kInfinity = 1e30f;` at src/pt_bvh.cpp:21, so kInvalidNode was undefined and the build would have failed; that is why I then declared it next to kInfinity before continuing with the API changes. I know this from my own archived tool result (#140) and the notes in #139/#141/#143 that describe adding the constant as the follow-up step.
